description: Checks a collection name against the naming law: lowercase letters, numbers, underscores; starts with a letter; 2-63 characters. Useful while planning collections, before any g.collection(name) call is written: a bad name throws from g.collection(name) before any network call — at module load that blanks the whole app with no console error. An invalid name comes back with a suggested fix.
name: validate_collection_name
title: Validate collection name
